title: SFT batch/LR sensitivity — measured GPU-hour and SU estimate

rate_sources.training: results/training_dynamics/sft/sft_training_manifest.json — 0.1556–0.1807 s/prompt at per_device_batch=1; accumulation does not change the per-prompt forward/backward cost
rate_sources.evaluation: 1237 batches at 1.15–1.4 it/s plus 300s load/NLS overhead, from logs/eval_*.log

cost_driver: Evaluation, not training. Training the entire program costs 10.9 GPU-h; the 108 test_goods checkpoint evaluations cost roughly three times that.
validation_cross_entropy_note: The frozen selection rule needs completion-only validation cross-entropy, which is recoverable on CPU from the teacher-forced Yes/No probabilities the standard evaluation already writes into loss_aversion_X/Y.json. It therefore needs NO extra GPU pass and is not costed separately.

scenarios.note: 12 cells; enough to APPLY the frozen batch-selection rule, which needs only endpoint validation cross-entropy
adds the within-run behavioural trajectory for each cell
